_comment: The Aqara S1 Plus's budgets (#68). Project choices, not published standards; docs/perf.md, "RAM", says why and how each is measured. Clarity's report (tools/perf/report.py) reads ram and panes. The pane budgets were set before the first per-pane measurement (2026-11-13); revisit them once one exists. A switchable pane's `state` is how its log shows it running (tools/perf/perflib.py pane_state): Assist by the wake word's microphone, Sendspin by its player. Assist is turned off with voice_enabled and its microphone mute (`mute`), because S1 Kiosk 0.4.3 loses a voice_enabled change across its restart (#158, s1v7).

radio.note: its processes run outside the app and are measured in place

timers.note: comes only with the voice assistant, so it is inside assist's share
